==Recipes==
Jagoite is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Jagoite is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Leafy Top]].  [[File:Shirt187.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a yellow dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Jagoite is not used in any [[quests]].
